from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class NonOperatingExpenditure(BaseModel):
    """Non-operating expenditure information from one company's financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name as it appears in the report")
    expenditure_amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric amount of non-operating expenditure")
    amount_unit: str | None = Field(description="The unit of the amount (e.g., '元', '万元')")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period for this financial data")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt containing the expenditure value")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    non_operating_expenditure_records: list[NonOperatingExpenditure]
